title: Building an AI App — Start with the User’s Stuck Moment
key_insight: Describe who is stuck, what input they have, and what successful output lets them do next. Then choose the smallest AI step that helps.
body:
## Start with the User’s Stuck Moment

A team begins with “add AI” and builds a chat box nobody needs. The missing piece is a specific job.

Describe who is stuck, what input they have, and what successful output lets them do next. Then choose the smallest AI step that helps.

Keep a non-AI path for cases where rules or search solve the task more reliably.
common_mistakes: Adding a chat box automatically creates user value.
Fluent output proves the user task succeeded.
A production app needs no fallback path.
mini_exercise: Draw “Start with the User’s Stuck Moment” as three steps and explain each one.
real_world_usage: A useful AI app connects a clear user job to context, model calls, validation, feedback, and fallback behavior.
explain_back_prompt: Use “Start with the User’s Stuck Moment” to explain Building an AI App plainly.
